n.description: int. Number of rows of the array for which the indices are returned.

k.description: optional, int, default=0. Specifies the sub-diagonal on and above which the indices of upper triangle are returned. ``k=0`` refers to main diagonal, ``k<0`` refers to sub-diagonal below the main diagonal and ``k>0`` refers to sub-diagonal above the main diagonal.

m.description: optional, int. Number of columns of the array for which the indices are returned. If not specified, then ``m = n``.

output.description: A tuple of two arrays containing the indices of the upper triangle, one along each axis.
